name: OWASP AI Security Verification Standard (AISVS)

levels.1: Essential baseline controls for all AI systems
levels.2: Standard controls for production / sensitive-data systems
levels.3: Advanced controls for high-assurance / critical environments

note: Chapters are the authoritative AISVS taxonomy. The requirements below are a curated, representative subset that Grey Panda verifies or guides on; consult the full AISVS for the complete requirement list.

controls.title: Training Data Integrity & Traceability
controls.description: Provenance, integrity, and traceability of training and fine-tuning data.

requirements.text: Training and fine-tuning data sources are documented with provenance.
Data integrity is verified (hashes/signatures) before training.

controls.title: Input Validation
controls.description: Validation, sanitization, and trust-tagging of all inputs to the model.

requirements.text: Untrusted input is separated from instructions (structural separation).
Inputs are screened for known injection patterns and invisible Unicode.
Retrieved and external content is tagged as untrusted before use.

controls.title: Model Lifecycle Management & Change Control
controls.description: Governed lifecycle and change control for models.

requirements.text: Model versions and changes are tracked and approved.

controls.title: Infrastructure, Configuration & Deployment Security
controls.description: Hardened, least-privilege deployment of AI components.

requirements.text: No secrets are hardcoded in source or config.
AI services run containerized, non-root, network-restricted.

controls.title: Access Control & Identity for AI Components & Users
controls.description: Authentication and authorization for AI components and users.

requirements.text: AI components authenticate with scoped, least-privilege identities.
Retrieval is filtered by the requesting user's identity.

controls.title: Supply Chain Security for Models
controls.description: Integrity and provenance of models, datasets, and dependencies.

requirements.text: AI dependencies are pinned to exact versions.
An AIBOM/AgBOM is produced and reviewed.

controls.title: Model Behavior, Output Control & Safety Assurance
controls.description: Control and validation of model outputs before downstream use.

requirements.text: Model output is not rendered as HTML/SQL/code without sanitization/validation.
Output is scanned for sensitive data before it leaves the system.

controls.title: Memory, Embeddings & Vector Database Security
controls.description: Security of memory, embeddings, and vector stores.

requirements.text: Vector queries enforce per-user access filters.
Memory writes are validated and attributed.

controls.title: Orchestration & Agentic Security
controls.description: Security of agent orchestration, tools, and autonomy.

requirements.text: Tools are deny-by-default with an explicit allowlist.
Irreversible actions require human-in-the-loop approval.
Agents do not hold the full lethal trifecta without an approval gate (Rule of Two).
A kill switch halts agent tool calls within seconds.

controls.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Security
controls.description: Security of MCP servers, clients, and tools.

requirements.text: Tool manifests are pinned and hashed; changes (rug pulls) are detected.
Tool inputs/outputs are schema-validated and treated as untrusted.
Remote MCP connections use TLS and OAuth 2.1/OIDC; no token passthrough.
MCP tool descriptions are checked for poisoning markers.
MCP tools never pass model input to a shell/eval sink.

controls.title: Adversarial Robustness
controls.description: Resistance to adversarial and evasion attacks.

requirements.text: The system is red-teamed for prompt injection and evasion before launch.
Security-relevant AI events are logged with no raw prompt/response text.
Audit events are shipped to a monitored SIEM with alerting.
